content.value_statement: IdeaVim tests can accumulate disabled cases, unclear exclusions, and weak sample text. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused maintenance checks and safe test-only updates.
actual_capabilities: Selects a small IdeaVim test area or a random test file for review.
Finds disabled tests and checks whether they can be documented or re-enabled.
Reviews Neovim exclusion annotations for clear reasons and descriptions.
Identifies meaningless test strings and suggests clearer test content.
Checks Vim behavior difference annotations for current documentation quality.
Summarizes test-only changes for a focused pull request.
limitations: It is scoped to test maintenance and does not fix production code defects.
It assumes the user is working inside the IdeaVim repository.
It may need a working Gradle and Kotlin test environment to verify changes.
It cannot prove flaky behavior without repeated local test runs.

use_cases.title: Review Disabled Tests
use_cases.description: Audit disabled IdeaVim tests and decide whether each one needs documentation, re-enabling, or removal.

use_cases.title: Improve Test Documentation
use_cases.description: Check Neovim exclusions and behavior difference notes for clear, current explanations.

use_cases.title: Clean Test Readability
use_cases.description: Replace unclear sample text in tests with realistic content that better explains the behavior under test.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Test File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner maintenance pass on a single file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review one IdeaVim test file for disabled tests, unclear exclusion reasons, and weak sample text. Suggest only test-only changes.

prompt_templates.title: Document Neovim Exclusions
prompt_templates.prompt: Find tests with Neovim exclusions in the selected area. Check whether each reason has a clear explanation and propose concise documentation updates.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Test Readability
prompt_templates.scenario: Quality pass for test content and names.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect a small group of IdeaVim tests for unclear names and meaningless sample text. Recommend clearer test content without changing production code.

prompt_templates.title: Run Maintenance Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Select a small test area, inspect disabled tests, verify Neovim annotations, run targeted tests when appropriate, and summarize any safe test-only changes.

output_examples.input: Review a selected IdeaVim test class for disabled tests.
output: Reported one disabled test with a clear reason that should stay disabled.
Identified one disabled test that may be re-enabled after a targeted local run.
Suggested a focused pull request title and summary.

output_examples.input: Check Neovim exclusion documentation in a test folder.
output: Listed exclusions with missing or vague explanations.
Suggested short descriptions for non-obvious cases.
Flagged cases that may be split into Vim-compatible and IDE-specific tests.

output_examples.input: Improve readability for tests that use placeholder text.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes realistic sample text, explains why the new text improves the test, and keeps the change limited to tests.

best_practices: Work on a small test area so each change remains easy to review.
Run targeted tests before re-enabling disabled cases when the environment allows it.
Keep every change limited to tests, annotations, and maintenance documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not change production code while using this maintenance workflow.
Do not remove a disabled test before confirming the covered feature is obsolete.
Do not leave Neovim exclusions without a clear reason when the difference is not obvious.

faq.question: What project is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for the IdeaVim test suite and its Kotlin-based tests.

faq.question: Can it fix product bugs?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly limits work to tests and test documentation.

faq.question: Does it require running tests?
faq.answer: Some checks can be done by review, but re-enabling tests should use targeted local test runs.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What does it check for Neovim?
faq.answer: It checks whether tests excluded from Neovim verification have clear and current reasons.

faq.question: What output should a user expect?
faq.answer: Expect a concise report of checked files, suggested test-only changes, and any verification results.
